name: Alex Morgan
role: Senior Editor, Public Holidays, Policy & Civic Calendars
bio: Alex Morgan is the Senior Editor for public holidays, policy and civic calendars at Fresh Calendars News. Alex leads coverage of federal, state, provincial and municipal holidays, statutory holiday rules, observed dates when a holiday falls on a weekend, and government changes to holiday calendars in the United States, the United Kingdom and Canada. Alex's stories explain who sets each date, which rules apply and what the day means for workers, schools, businesses and travel. Every legal or date claim is checked against the official calendar, law or agency notice it comes from.
